seoTitle: Dividend Yield Calculator With Annual Income
metaDescription: Calculate dividend yield, yield on cost and yearly dividend income from share price, dividend and shares held.
intro: Dividend yield, yield on your cost and annual income, with optional withholding tax.
why:
Dividend yield is annual dividend divided by share price. It moves with the price, so a very high yield can signal a falling price or a dividend at risk.

Enter the dividend for the next or last 12 months. Yield on cost uses your purchase price, and an optional withholding rate shows the net income.
howTo: Enter price, annual dividend and shares held.
Optionally add your purchase price and withholding tax.

faq.a: The total of the last 12 months or the declared next 12 months. Avoid one-off special dividends.
It applies a flat rate you enter. Real rules vary.
No, it is a single-year view.
